{
 "cells": [
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "id": "00c114e6-0e44-4589-9739-524784e0b0cb",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import fusionsc as fsc\n",
    "from fusionsc.devices import w7x\n",
    "import numpy as np"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "id": "a67ba458-d4ba-48aa-9c2a-9e6fd79652b3",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "geo = w7x.op21Geometry().index(w7x.defaultGeometryGrid())\n",
    "field = w7x.standard().compute(w7x.defaultGrid())"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "id": "a151dc0f-8663-499c-8a99-27ea1c32f32b",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "#mapping = w7x.computeMapping(field, toroidalSymmetry = 5).mapGeometry(geo.triangulate(0.02))"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "id": "447c43cb-52ba-4911-b69a-6de579141b8b",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "phi = np.radians(200.8)\n",
    "\n",
    "startR = np.linspace(5.5, 7, 150)\n",
    "startZ = np.linspace(-0.2, -0.15, 50)\n",
    "\n",
    "startR, startZ = np.meshgrid(startR, startZ, indexing = \"ij\")\n",
    "\n",
    "x = startR * np.cos(phi)\n",
    "y = startR * np.sin(phi)\n",
    "z = startZ"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "id": "871943e3-1dac-4d11-a013-1174ea2fb869",
   "metadata": {
    "scrolled": true
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "traceResult = fsc.flt.trace(\n",
    "    [x, y, z],\n",
    "    field,\n",
    "    geometry = geo,\n",
    "    #mapping = mapping, stepSize = 13,\n",
    "    minStepSize = 0.001, maxStepSize = 0.1,\n",
    "    targetError = 1e-3,\n",
    "    \n",
    "    collisionLimit = 1, distanceLimit = 2e3,\n",
    "\n",
    "    direction = \"cw\" # Possible values: ccw, cw, forward (field direction), backward (against field direction)\n",
    ")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 7,
   "id": "b575039d-1b97-4a46-b0a6-a7eb488b5281",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "Text(0, 0.5, 'Z')"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 7,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    },
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 640x480 with 2 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "\n",
    "# This array has the same shape as the XYZ array you put in\n",
    "# as points\n",
    "\n",
    "# You can put in arrays of whatever dimensionality you want\n",
    "# except that on input the first dimension has to be 3 (X, Y, Z)\n",
    "# and on output you get the dimensions X, Y, Z, connection length\n",
    "\n",
    "x, y, z, conLen = traceResult[\"endPoints\"]\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.imshow(conLen.T, origin = \"lower\", extent = [startR.min(), startR.max(), startZ.min(), startZ.max()])\n",
    "plt.colorbar()\n",
    "plt.xlabel(\"R\")\n",
    "plt.ylabel(\"Z\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 8,
   "id": "29a18f7e-2732-4a49-b2cb-a0c5a329e6d3",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stderr",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "C:\\Users\\Knieps\\AppData\\Local\\Python\\pythoncore-3.13-64\\Lib\\site-packages\\pyvista\\jupyter\\notebook.py:36: UserWarning: Failed to use notebook backend: \n",
      "\n",
      "No module named 'trame'\n",
      "\n",
      "Falling back to a static output.\n",
      "  warnings.warn(\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "data": {
      "image/jpeg": "",
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<PIL.Image.Image image mode=RGB size=1024x768>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "import pyvista as pv\n",
    "\n",
    "# Filter field lines by whether they stopped due to hitting a geometry\n",
    "mask = traceResult[\"stopReasons\"] == \"collisionLimit\"\n",
    "\n",
    "xMasked = x[mask]\n",
    "yMasked = y[mask]\n",
    "zMasked = z[mask]\n",
    "\n",
    "pl = pv.Plotter()\n",
    "pl.add_points(np.asarray([xMasked, yMasked, zMasked]).reshape([3, -1]).T)\n",
    "pl.show()"
   ]
  },
